fields.label: Periodic Test 1 (Pre-Mid-Term) - Physics
fields.note: CBSE's syllabus suggests the pre-mid-term test in July-August; the school sets the exact date.

fields.label: Half-Yearly Examination - Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics
fields.note: CBSE's syllabus suggests the mid-term test in November; the school sets the exact date and paper pattern.

fields.label: Physics Practical Examination
fields.note: CBSE Physics practical: 30 marks - two experiments (7+7), record 5, one activity 3, project 3, viva 5. Date set by the school.
